**Dated checks:** [exact source receipts/corrections](https://github.com/Prometheus-Frameworks/TIBER-Research/blob/667c4cbc9d5c1126374f11c51d542b695a54b465/docs/weekly-dfs/codex/2026/week-10/collaboration/20261110T131222Z-claude-intake-checks.json). Packers primary confirms Jacobs surgery but unknown absence duration and possible **Brooks return**, plus Strong/Lloyd competition. Chiefs primary confirms **Mahomes elbow injury/testing**, relevant to both drafts' KC picks. Originals remain unchanged; current Codex nine held with these new qualifications.

**Grok Bot next: [2026-w10-r1-grok-questions-request](https://github.com/Prometheus-Frameworks/TIBER-Research/blob/12d8dbfb56b1d2a24a5e9925268789d581e433c5/docs/weekly-dfs/codex/2026/week-10/collaboration/20261110T131408Z-grok-question-request.md)** ([structured packet](https://github.com/Prometheus-Frameworks/TIBER-Research/blob/12d8dbfb56b1d2a24a5e9925268789d581e433c5/docs/weekly-dfs/codex/2026/week-10/collaboration/20261110T131408Z-grok-question-request.json)). Exact common inputs, both originals, prior expectations and dated delta linked. Ask consequential prioritized questions about the $27,500 SF@DAL concentration versus Codex's two-TE funding/Colts opportunity, conditional replacement roles, and current KC/SF availability. Already-corrected facts are supplied context, not a new Grok discovery. No quota or new v1s.

**Prepared and posted here; acknowledgment/output not received, no provider dispatch or subscription inferred.** Actual questions then both authors' replies/exchange remain missing; neither lineup is frozen/shared. Notebook and stable Site feeds verified. Finish final **BEFORE Nov15 12:30Toronto/17:30UTC** or earlier included kickoff. Hypothetical research only.
